summary.method: nearest in time, linear in lat/lon/depth (xarray.interp)
summary.pairing_note: Display window is +/-5 days centred on the analysis timestamp. The analysis's own assimilation window is wider: T_BOXOBS = 28-30 profiles/step over this region against ~20 profiles in a strict 10-day bucket (measured 2026-09-22).
cf_assumptions: units 'degs' is not UDUNITS; read as 'degree_Celsius'
no standard_name; assumed 'sea_water_temperature' from variable identity
depth coordinate 'ZAX' has no 'positive' attribute; assumed positive-down because values are non-negative and ascending

notes: top level carried to the surface (mixed-layer assumption)
rho 1025.0 kg/m3, cp 3991.868 J/(kg K) (TEOS-10 cp0)

assumptions: QC scale: Copernicus In Situ TAC (Argo-numbered); accepted ['1', '2', '5', '8']; flag 0 means no QC performed
position from PRECISE_LATITUDE/LONGITUDE per record, not the nominal mooring site
platform: RAMA BUOY : 15N 90E (BOBOA) (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration - Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory)
